  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure (E × ℝ))
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P],
  MeasureTheory.Measure.map Prod.fst P = ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E →
    ∀ (p : Polynomial ℝ) (hlabel : MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun (z : E × ℝ) => z.2) 2 P),
      let S := { w : E // ‖w‖ = 1 };
      have f := fun (w : E) (z : E × ℝ) => Polynomial.eval (inner ℝ w z.1) p;
      have df := fun (w v : E) (z : E × ℝ) => Polynomial.eval (inner ℝ w z.1) (Polynomial.derivative p) * inner ℝ v z.1;
      have predictor := fun (ρ : MeasureTheory.Measure S) (x : E) => ∫ (w : S), Polynomial.eval (inner ℝ (↑w) x) p ∂ρ;
      have V := fun (ρ : MeasureTheory.Measure S) (w : E) =>
        2 * ∫ (z : E × ℝ), (predictor ρ z.1 - z.2) * Polynomial.eval (inner ℝ w z.1) p ∂P;
      ∃ (hf : ∀ (w : E), MeasureTheory.MemLp (f w) 2 P) (hdf : ∀ (w v : E), MeasureTheory.MemLp (df w v) 2 P) (D :
        E → E →L[ℝ] ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℝ 2 P)) (M₁ : ℝ) (M₂ : ℝ),
        have F := fun (w : E) => MeasureTheory.MemLp.toLp (f w) ⋯;
        have label := MeasureTheory.MemLp.toLp (fun (z : E × ℝ) => z.2) hlabel;
        have K := fun (w : S) => F ↑w;
        have mean := fun (ρ : MeasureTheory.Measure S) => ∫ (w : S), K w ∂ρ;
        have G := fun (ρ : MeasureTheory.Measure S) (w : E) => gradient (V ρ) w - inner ℝ (gradient (V ρ) w) w • w;
        0 < M₁ ∧
          0 < M₂ ∧
            (∀ (w v : E), (D w) v = MeasureTheory.MemLp.toLp (df w v) ⋯) ∧
              (∀ (w : E), HasFDerivAt F (D w) w) ∧
                (∀ (w : E), ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ‖D w‖ ≤ M₁) ∧
                  (∀ (w u : E), ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ‖D w - D u‖ ≤ M₂ * ‖w - u‖) ∧
                    ∀ (ρ : MeasureTheory.Measure S),
                      MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
                        (∀ (x : E), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun (w : S) => Polynomial.eval (inner ℝ (↑w) x) p) ρ) ∧
                          MeasureTheory.Integrable K ρ ∧
                            (∃ (hpred : MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun (z : E × ℝ) => predictor ρ z.1) 2 P),
                                MeasureTheory.MemLp.toLp (fun (z : E × ℝ) => predictor ρ z.1) hpred = mean ρ) ∧
                              (V ρ = fun (w : E) => 2 * inner ℝ (mean ρ - label) (F w)) ∧
                                (∀ (w : E),
                                    MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                        (fun (z : E × ℝ) => (predictor ρ z.1 - z.2) * Polynomial.eval (inner ℝ w z.1) p)
                                        P ∧
                                      HasGradientAt (V ρ) (2 • (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (D w)) (mean ρ - label)) w ∧
                                        gradient (V ρ) w = 2 • (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (D w)) (mean ρ - label)) ∧
                                  ∀ (w : S),
                                    G ρ ↑w =
                                      2 •
                                        ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (D ↑w)) (mean ρ - label) -
                                          inner ℝ ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (D ↑w)) (mean ρ - label)) ↑w • ↑w)

theorem gaussian_polynomial_joint_feature_gradient_representation
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (P : Measure (E × ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hGaussian : P.map Prod.fst = ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E)
    (p : Polynomial ℝ) (hlabel : MemLp (fun z : E × ℝ => z.2) 2 P) :
    let S := {w : E // ‖w‖ = 1}
    let f : E → E × ℝ → ℝ := fun w z => p.eval ⟪w,z.1⟫_ℝ
    let df : E → E → E × ℝ → ℝ := fun w v z =>
      p.derivative.eval ⟪w,z.1⟫_ℝ * ⟪v,z.1⟫_ℝ
    let predictor : Measure S → E → ℝ := fun ρ x =>
      ∫ w : S, p.eval ⟪w.1,x⟫_ℝ ∂ρ
    let V : Measure S → E → ℝ := fun ρ w =>
      2 * ∫ z : E × ℝ, (predictor ρ z.1-z.2)*p.eval ⟪w,z.1⟫_ℝ ∂P
    ∃ hf : ∀ w : E, MemLp (f w) 2 P,
    ∃ hdf : ∀ w v : E, MemLp (df w v) 2 P,
    ∃ D : E → E →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 P,
    ∃ M₁ M₂ : ℝ,
      let F : E → Lp ℝ 2 P := fun w => (hf w).toLp (f w)
      let label : Lp ℝ 2 P := hlabel.toLp (fun z : E × ℝ => z.2)
      let K : S → Lp ℝ 2 P := fun w => F w.1
      let mean : Measure S → Lp ℝ 2 P := fun ρ => ∫ w : S, K w ∂ρ
      let G : Measure S → E → E := fun ρ w =>
        gradient (V ρ) w-⟪gradient (V ρ) w,w⟫_ℝ • w
      0 < M₁ ∧ 0 < M₂ ∧
      (∀ w v : E, D w v = (hdf w v).toLp (df w v)) ∧
      (∀ w : E, HasFDerivAt F (D w) w) ∧
      (∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ‖D w‖ ≤ M₁) ∧
      (∀ w u : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ‖u‖ ≤ 1 →
        ‖D w-D u‖ ≤ M₂*‖w-u‖) ∧
      ∀ ρ : Measure S, IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
        (∀ x : E, Integrable (fun w : S => p.eval ⟪w.1,x⟫_ℝ) ρ) ∧
        Integrable K ρ ∧
        (∃ hpred : MemLp (fun z : E × ℝ => predictor ρ z.1) 2 P,
          hpred.toLp (fun z : E × ℝ => predictor ρ z.1) = mean ρ) ∧
        (V ρ = fun w : E => 2 * ⟪mean ρ-label,F w⟫_ℝ) ∧
        (∀ w : E,
          Integrable (fun z : E × ℝ =>
            (predictor ρ z.1-z.2)*p.eval ⟪w,z.1⟫_ℝ) P ∧
          HasGradientAt (V ρ) ((2 : ℝ) • (D w).adjoint (mean ρ-label)) w ∧
          gradient (V ρ) w = (2 : ℝ) • (D w).adjoint (mean ρ-label)) ∧
        ∀ w : S,
          G ρ w.1 = (2 : ℝ) • ((D w.1).adjoint (mean ρ-label) -
            ⟪(D w.1).adjoint (mean ρ-label),w.1⟫_ℝ • w.1) := by
  classical
  let : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℝ E
  dsimp only
  let S := {w : E // ‖w‖ = 1}
  let predictor : Measure S → E → ℝ := fun μ x => ∫ w, p.eval ⟪w.1,x⟫_ℝ ∂μ
  let V : Measure S → E → ℝ := fun μ w =>
    2 * ∫ z, (predictor μ z.1-z.2)*p.eval ⟪w,z.1⟫_ℝ ∂P
  obtain ⟨hf,hdf,D,hD,hDiff,M₁,M₂,hM₁,hM₂,hBound,hLip⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.GaussianPolynomialDifferentiation.actual_gaussian_polynomial_ridge_L2_derivative_bounds (E := E) p
  have hmarg : MeasurePreserving (Prod.fst : E × ℝ → E) P (stdGaussian E) :=
    ⟨measurable_fst,hGaussian⟩
  let J : Lp ℝ 2 (stdGaussian E) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 P :=
    Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℝ Prod.fst hmarg
  let T : Lp ℝ 2 (stdGaussian E) →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 P := J.toContinuousLinearMap
  let hfP : ∀ w : E, MemLp (fun z : E × ℝ => p.eval ⟪w,z.1⟫_ℝ) 2 P :=
    fun w => (hf w).comp_measurePreserving hmarg
  let hdfP : ∀ w v : E,
      MemLp (fun z : E × ℝ => p.derivative.eval ⟪w,z.1⟫_ℝ * ⟪v,z.1⟫_ℝ) 2 P :=
    fun w v => (hdf w v).comp_measurePreserving hmarg
  let F : E → Lp ℝ 2 P := fun w => (hfP w).toLp (fun z => p.eval ⟪w,z.1⟫_ℝ)
  let DP : E → E →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 P := fun w => T.comp (D w)
  have hDP (w v : E) : DP w v =
      (hdfP w v).toLp (fun z => p.derivative.eval ⟪w,z.1⟫_ℝ * ⟪v,z.1⟫_ℝ) := by
    change T (D w v) = _
    rw [hD w v]
    rfl
  have hFeq (w : E) : F w = T ((hf w).toLp (fun x => p.eval ⟪w,x⟫_ℝ)) := rfl
  have hFP (w : E) : HasFDerivAt F (DP w) w := by
    have he : F = fun u => T ((hf u).toLp (fun x => p.eval ⟪u,x⟫_ℝ)) := funext hFeq
    rw [he]
    exact T.hasFDerivAt.comp w (hDiff w)
  have hPB (w : E) (hw : ‖w‖ ≤ 1) : ‖DP w‖ ≤ M₁ := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hM₁.le
    intro v
    change ‖J (D w v)‖ ≤ M₁*‖v‖
    rw [J.norm_map]
    exact ((D w).le_opNorm v).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hBound w hw) (norm_nonneg v))
  have hPL (w u : E) (hw : ‖w‖ ≤ 1) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) :
      ‖DP w-DP u‖ ≤ M₂*‖w-u‖ := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (mul_nonneg hM₂.le (norm_nonneg _))
    intro v
    change ‖T (D w v)-T (D u v)‖ ≤ (M₂*‖w-u‖)*‖v‖
    rw [← map_sub]
    change ‖J ((D w-D u) v)‖ ≤ (M₂*‖w-u‖)*‖v‖
    rw [J.norm_map]
    exact ((D w-D u).le_opNorm v).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hLip u w hu hw) (norm_nonneg v))
  let label : Lp ℝ 2 P := hlabel.toLp (fun z : E × ℝ => z.2)
  let K : S → Lp ℝ 2 P := fun w => F w.1
  let mean : Measure S → Lp ℝ 2 P := fun μ => ∫ w, K w ∂μ
  obtain ⟨hfS,hcont,havg⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.GaussianPolynomialAveraging.gaussian_polynomial_parameter_average_L2 (E := E) p
  have hKint (μ : Measure S) (hμ : IsProbabilityMeasure μ) : Integrable K μ := by
    exact T.integrable_comp (havg μ hμ).2.1
  have hMeanClass (μ : Measure S) (hμ : IsProbabilityMeasure μ) :
      ∃ hpred : MemLp (fun z : E × ℝ => predictor μ z.1) 2 P,
        hpred.toLp (fun z => predictor μ z.1) = mean μ := by
    obtain ⟨hscalar,hint,hmean,hident⟩ := havg μ hμ
    let hpred : MemLp (fun z : E × ℝ => predictor μ z.1) 2 P :=
      hmean.comp_measurePreserving hmarg
    refine ⟨hpred,?_⟩
    calc
      hpred.toLp (fun z => predictor μ z.1) = T (hmean.toLp (predictor μ)) := rfl
      _ = T (∫ w, (hfS w).toLp (fun x => p.eval ⟪w.1,x⟫_ℝ) ∂μ) := congrArg T hident
      _ = mean μ := (T.integral_comp_comm hint).symm
  have hMeanAE (μ : Measure S) (hμ : IsProbabilityMeasure μ) :
      (fun z => mean μ z) =ᵐ[P] (fun z : E × ℝ => predictor μ z.1) := by
    obtain ⟨hpred,hident⟩ := hMeanClass μ hμ
    rw [← hident]
    exact hpred.coeFn_toLp
  have hResidual (μ : Measure S) (hμ : IsProbabilityMeasure μ) :
      (fun z => (mean μ-label) z) =ᵐ[P] (fun z : E × ℝ => predictor μ z.1-z.2) := by
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (mean μ) label,hMeanAE μ hμ,hlabel.coeFn_toLp]
      with z hs hm hy
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hs
    rw [hs,hm,hy]
  have hPot (μ : Measure S) (hμ : IsProbabilityMeasure μ) :
      V μ = fun w => 2 * ⟪mean μ-label,F w⟫_ℝ := by
    funext w
    change 2 * (∫ z, (predictor μ z.1-z.2)*p.eval ⟪w,z.1⟫_ℝ ∂P) = _
    rw [L2.inner_def]
    congr 1
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hResidual μ hμ,(hfP w).coeFn_toLp] with z hr hw
    change F w z = p.eval ⟪w,z.1⟫_ℝ at hw
    simp only [Real.inner_apply,hr,hw]
  have hTangent :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Geometry.QuadraticFeatureTangentGradient.quadratic_feature_potential_tangent_gradient
      F DP hFP M₁ M₂ hM₁.le hM₂.le hPB hPL
  have hGrad (μ : Measure S) (hμ : IsProbabilityMeasure μ) (w : E) :
      HasGradientAt (V μ) ((2 : ℝ) • (DP w).adjoint (mean μ-label)) w := by
    rw [hPot μ hμ,hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt]
    have he : InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E ((2 : ℝ) • (DP w).adjoint (mean μ-label)) =
        (2 : ℝ) • innerSL ℝ ((DP w).adjoint (mean μ-label)) := by
      ext v
      simp [InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply,innerSL_apply_apply]
    rw [he]
    exact hTangent.1 (mean μ-label) w
  refine ⟨hfP,hdfP,DP,M₁,M₂,hM₁,hM₂,hDP,hFP,hPB,hPL,?_⟩
  intro μ hμ
  refine ⟨(havg μ hμ).1,hKint μ hμ,hMeanClass μ hμ,hPot μ hμ,?_,?_⟩
  · intro w
    obtain ⟨hpred,hident⟩ := hMeanClass μ hμ
    exact ⟨(hpred.sub hlabel).integrable_mul (hfP w),hGrad μ hμ w,(hGrad μ hμ w).gradient⟩
  · intro w
    change gradient (V μ) w.1 - ⟪gradient (V μ) w.1,w.1⟫_ℝ • w.1 = _
    rw [(hGrad μ hμ w.1).gradient]
    simp only [smul_sub,real_inner_smul_left,smul_smul]
    rfl

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.GaussianPolynomialFeatureGradient

publication_context.statement: Let \(E\) be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel structure, let \(\gamma=\operatorname{stdGaussian}(E)\), and let \(S=\{w\in E:\|w\|=1\}\). Let \(P\) be a probability measure on \(E\times\mathbb R\) whose first marginal is \(\gamma\). Fix a real polynomial \(p\), and assume the actual response \((x,y)\mapsto y\) belongs to \(H=L^2(P;\mathbb R)\). Define the literal feature and directional derivative by \(f_w(x,y)=p(\langle w,x\rangle)\) and \(df_{w,v}(x,y)=p^{\prime}(\langle w,x\rangle)\langle v,x\rangle\). All these functions belong to \(H\). There exist one family of continuous linear maps \(D(w):E\to H\) and positive constants \(M_1,M_2\), chosen before every parameter law and every subsequent evaluation point, with the following properties. Writing \(F(w)=[f_w]\), we have \(D(w)v=[df_{w,v}]\) and \(F\) has Fréchet derivative \(D(w)\) at every ambient \(w\). The displayed operator bounds hold on the closed unit ball. For every probability \(\rho\) on \(S\), all scalar sections defining the predictor are integrable, \(F|_S\) is Bochner integrable, and the predictor composed with the first-coordinate map belongs to \(H\), with class equal to its Bochner mean \(m_\rho\). The literal scalar potential has an integrable defining integrand at every ambient \(w\); it equals \(2\langle m_\rho-\ell,F(w)\rangle_H\) and has actual ambient gradient \(2D(w)^*(m_\rho-\ell)\) there. On the unit sphere, subtracting the normal component gives the final displayed projection formula. The same \(D,M_1,M_2\) is used throughout.

steps.title: Use the Gaussian L² derivative and its uniform bounds
steps.text: In \(H_0=L^2(\gamma)\), the existing polynomial-feature theorem supplies the classes \(\Phi(w)=[p(\langle w,\cdot\rangle)]_\gamma\), their actual derivative \(D_0(w)\), and positive bounds \(M_1,M_2\) on the closed unit ball. Its directional formula identifies the derivative class explicitly. These facts are outputs of that parent, so no derivative witness is assumed here.
steps.formula: D_0(w)v=[p^{\prime}(\langle w,x\rangle)\langle v,x\rangle]_\gamma,\quad \mathrm d\Phi(w)=D_0(w),\quad \|D_0(w)\|\le M_1,\quad \|D_0(w)-D_0(u)\|\le M_2\|w-u\|.

steps.title: Pull the feature and derivative into the joint law
steps.text: The first-marginal identity makes \(\mathrm{fst}\) measure preserving. Pullback gives a linear isometry \(J:H_0\to H\). Set \(F=J\Phi\) and \(D(w)=J\circ D_0(w)\). Pullback preserves the literal feature and directional-derivative classes. The chain rule gives the derivative of \(F\), and the isometry preserves the same operator bounds, with no use of response/input independence.
steps.lean:
have hmarg : MeasurePreserving (Prod.fst : E × ℝ → E) P (stdGaussian E) :=
    ⟨measurable_fst,hGaussian⟩
  let J : Lp ℝ 2 (stdGaussian E) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 P :=
    Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℝ Prod.fst hmarg
  let T : Lp ℝ 2 (stdGaussian E) →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 P := J.toContinuousLinearMap
  let hfP : ∀ w : E, MemLp (fun z : E × ℝ => p.eval ⟪w,z.1⟫_ℝ) 2 P :=
    fun w => (hf w).comp_measurePreserving hmarg
  let hdfP : ∀ w v : E,
      MemLp (fun z : E × ℝ => p.derivative.eval ⟪w,z.1⟫_ℝ * ⟪v,z.1⟫_ℝ) 2 P :=
    fun w v => (hdf w v).comp_measurePreserving hmarg
  let F : E → Lp ℝ 2 P := fun w => (hfP w).toLp (fun z => p.eval ⟪w,z.1⟫_ℝ)
  let DP : E → E →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 P := fun w => T.comp (D w)
  have hDP (w v : E) : DP w v =
      (hdfP w v).toLp (fun z => p.derivative.eval ⟪w,z.1⟫_ℝ * ⟪v,z.1⟫_ℝ) := by
    change T (D w v) = _
    rw [hD w v]
    rfl
  have hFeq (w : E) : F w = T ((hf w).toLp (fun x => p.eval ⟪w,x⟫_ℝ)) := rfl
  have hFP (w : E) : HasFDerivAt F (DP w) w := by
    have he : F = fun u => T ((hf u).toLp (fun x => p.eval ⟪u,x⟫_ℝ)) := funext hFeq
    rw [he]
    exact T.hasFDerivAt.comp w (hDiff w)
  have hPB (w : E) (hw : ‖w‖ ≤ 1) : ‖DP w‖ ≤ M₁ := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hM₁.le
    intro v
    change ‖J (D w v)‖ ≤ M₁*‖v‖
    rw [J.norm_map]
    exact ((D w).le_opNorm v).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hBound w hw) (norm_nonneg v))
  have hPL (w u : E) (hw : ‖w‖ ≤ 1) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) :
      ‖DP w-DP u‖ ≤ M₂*‖w-u‖ := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (mul_nonneg hM₂.le (norm_nonneg _))
    intro v
    change ‖T (D w v)-T (D u v)‖ ≤ (M₂*‖w-u‖)*‖v‖
    rw [← map_sub]
    change ‖J ((D w-D u) v)‖ ≤ (M₂*‖w-u‖)*‖v‖
    rw [J.norm_map]
    exact ((D w-D u).le_opNorm v).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hLip u w hu hw) (norm_nonneg v))

steps.title: Identify the actual predictor class with the Bochner mean
steps.text: The Gaussian parameter-average theorem proves scalar-section and Bochner integrability and identifies the predictor class in \(H_0\). Pull this class through \(J\) and commute the continuous linear map with the Bochner integral. This proves integrability of \(F|_S\) and identifies \(m_\rho\) with the actual predictor class in \(H\).

    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.GaussianPolynomialAveraging.gaussian_polynomial_parameter_average_L2 (E := E) p
  have hKint (μ : Measure S) (hμ : IsProbabilityMeasure μ) : Integrable K μ := by
    exact T.integrable_comp (havg μ hμ).2.1

      ∃ hpred : MemLp (fun z : E × ℝ => predictor μ z.1) 2 P,
        hpred.toLp (fun z => predictor μ z.1) = mean μ := by
    obtain ⟨hscalar,hint,hmean,hident⟩ := havg μ hμ
    let hpred : MemLp (fun z : E × ℝ => predictor μ z.1) 2 P :=

reconstruction.text:
Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its compatible norm and Borel measurable structure. Let P be a probability measure on E x R whose first-coordinate marginal is the standard Gaussian measure on E. Here standard Gaussian means the pushforward of independent centered variance-one real Gaussians along (xi_j)_j -> sum_j xi_j e_j for the indicated orthonormal basis of E. There is no positive-dimension assumption. Let p be any real polynomial, and assume that the second-coordinate function ell(x,y)=y belongs to L2(P). No independence between the two coordinates, or Gaussian distribution for the second coordinate, is assumed.

Set S={w in E: ||w||=1}, equipped with its inherited measurable structure. Define the real functions
 f_w(x,y)=p(<w,x>),
 df_{w,v}(x,y)=p'(<w,x>)<v,x>,
where p' is the ordinary polynomial derivative and the inner product is the real ambient inner product. For any measure rho on S define the pointwise scalar predictor
 q_rho(x)=int_S p(<w,x>) d rho(w)
and the scalar ambient potential
 V_rho(w)=2 int_(E x R) (q_rho(x)-y)p(<w,x>) dP(x,y).

The theorem asserts the existence of proofs that f_w is in L2(P) for every w in E and df_{w,v} is in L2(P) for every w,v in E, together with a map D:E -> (E ->L_R L2(P)) and strictly positive real constants M1,M2. Use those integrability proofs to define
 F(w)=[f_w] in L2(P), label=[ell] in L2(P),
 K(w)=F(w) for w in S, and m_rho=int_S K(w) d rho(w).
The last integral is the Bochner integral with values in the real Hilbert space L2(P). Square brackets mean the P-almost-everywhere equivalence class supplied by MemLp.toLp, not equality of arbitrary pointwise representatives.

These witnesses satisfy all of the following:
(1) For every w,v in E, D(w)(v)=[df_{w,v}] in L2(P).
(2) For every w in E, F has real Frechet derivative D(w) at w. Equivalently, F(w+h)-F(w)-D(w)(h) is o(||h||) in the L2 norm as h tends to zero.
(3) For every w with ||w||<=1, the operator norm satisfies ||D(w)||<=M1.
(4) For every w,u with ||w||<=1 and ||u||<=1, ||D(w)-D(u)||<=M2||w-u||, using the operator norm on maps E -> L2(P).

Furthermore, for every probability measure rho on S, all the following conclusions hold together:
